svg.text: How Finclator keeps score on finance influencers
Five layers: collect → retrieve → extract → grade → vote. Regex → Jev gate → Qwen3.6-35B, then price does the rest.
Every cell in the matrix traces back to a quote, a date, and two closing prices.
pass 1: regex, names an asset at all
quote = exact span of the post
flat band = ½ σ of the asset’s move
one vote per account per cell
its latest call in the window
no single account can carry a cell
What one graded call looks like
every row on the audit page has these fields · the quote is highlighted inside the post
“After that, liquidity clusters around $66,000-$67,000 will start
→ one hit in this account’s BTC · SHORT trust cell

0–3 mo · 3–12 mo · 1–5 y. Click a cell for its voters,
each with their quote. Plus trust grids, method, full audit.
1,000 posts · reference = Claude Fable 5.1 · per (post, asset) call
Two frontier models disagree on 1 call in 10.
The gate cuts GPU work 80% for 2 pts of recall;
precision rises because the false positives differ.
